'''Bartaph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. After [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Graal]] disappeared during the riots that resulted from the [[Invasion of Belsavis|Imperial attack]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Bartaph was sent to Belsavis in order to serve as the prison's new warden.

After the [[Hero of Tython]] had defeated [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] and foiled his plan to destroy Belsavis, Bartaph confronted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as they were preparing to leave the planet, having learned that they had worked alongside the convict [[Pak Taldine]] to defeat Krannus. Bartaph demanded to know why the Hero of Tython had worked with Taldine, revealing his past as a notorious criminal, but the Hero of Typhon defended Taldine, saying that the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak's]] help was invaluable in their mission.

Although still skeptical, Bartaph ultimately agreed to take the Hero of Typhon's word and allowed Taldine to continue working with the Republic as he had been under former Warden [[Playt]].
